description: มุน 2026-08-03 (ฟีม, Figma Z1 636:19319 · Z2 636:19532 · Z3 636:22150 · Z4 636:22328): the compat result page below the hero refactored to the Figma design. FOUR bug-classes the pixels own, none visible to tsc/className review: (1) Z1 TAB SQUASH — equal-width tabs at 16px bold do not fit a narrow screen (measured: widest label 'ธาตุ & เสา' = 71px, a 320-wide screen gives 68px/tab). ฟีม ruled the row must SCROLL (scrollbar hidden) rather than squash, so the anchor asserts @393 tabs FILL the row (scrollWidth<=clientWidth, equal width ±1px) while @320 every tab stays >=86px AND scrollWidth>clientWidth AND the reserved scrollbar track is 0 AND the PAGE still has no overflow-x. Colours: container #ECF0FC, active = sapphire bg + LIME #E1FF00 text (was white), inactive transparent + sapphire. (2) Z2 CARD-INSIDE-A-CARD — Figma puts the 5 dimension rows inside ONE section card; keeping each row's white card bg reads as nested cards. Anchor asserts every row's computed background is transparent. (3) Z2 GRADE-RAMP DRIFT — the node draws FIVE steps (A #2E7D32 != B #66BB6A, C+ #CDDC39, C/C- #F57C00, D/F #B71C1C) where the old TIER_COLOR had four and merged A with B; the rationale box under each row carries the grade's SOFT pair (#E8F5E9/#F0F8F0/#F9FBE7/#FFF0E1/#FCE4EC) instead of a flat grey. Anchor asserts pill colour ALWAYS equals bar colour, each grade hits its sampled ramp colour, and A != B. gradeTier gained a 'best' tier; scripts/compat-tone.test.ts walks all 13 engine grades against the new map plus an explicit A!=B invariant. (4) Z3/Z4 SIDE-TINT — a shared self/other palette (ตัวเรา #ECF0FC / เขา #F9F4F0) on the pillar panels AND the person cards; a swap is invisible to review but wrong to the eye. Anchor asserts each panel/card by data-side, inner pillar cells stay white, and D23 (ยาม '—' when timeKnown=false) still holds. Z4's header uses 'รายคน' — Figma 636:22328's own title duplicates Zone 3's 'เทียบสี่เสาของทั้งสองฝ่าย' while showing per-person content, which I flagged as a copy-paste artifact in the file and ฟีม ruled against copying. Teeth-proven live (run-compat-zones.ts, 24/24): mut-tab-white-text, mut-nested-card, mut-tint-swap, mut-grade-colour-drift — all CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual (computed style + layout geometry + scroll metrics). Existing anchors re-run green (run-compat-3c 17/17, run-compat-2e2, run-compat-sprites 11/11). RESOLVED 2026-08-03 (see compat-element-palette): the ไม้/ไฟ/ทอง chips are now ฟีม-ruled and every element obeys the measured 16.2% tile rule. Did NOT touch pages/matching or constants/api/api-user-matching (git diff 0).
